description: Case Study of Cape Town Commuter Travel Preference Using Case 2 Best-Worst Scaling - Travel data for all Public Transport modes is a data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by University of Cape Town. This data is from the project: Case Study of Cape Town Commuter Travel Preference Using Case 2 Best-Worst Scaling.Abstract:A commuter preference study in Cape Town using Case 2 Best-Worst Scaling was conducted for Bus, Minibus Taxi (MBT), MyCiTi and Train commuters. Each commuter was presented with nine choice sets with varying attribute levels for travel. Coverage: South Africa. The portal files it under the publisher University of Cape Town. Its tags are Transport engineering, Transport economics, Public transport, Transport planning. The repository dates the deposit 2024; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
